title: You guys have got to check out the “telepathy tapes” podcast.
content: I’m only starting episode 2 and this really sounds like an extension or an aspect of what we’re talking about in here. It’s essentially a collection of interviews that these people, including a scientist from John’s Hopkins, are conducting with nonverbal children. I won’t say too much but some of these kids weren’t even aware that they had a physical body and had to learn how to perceive it… if this is real it definitely points to there probably being some higher plane of existence or consciousness. I’m going to have to do some serious digging into the authenticity of this experiment and podcast.
